articles.title: StrongestLayer Research Finds Trusted Platforms Like DocuSign and Google Calendar Are Now the Primary Email Attack Surface
articles.mainIdea: StrongestLayer Research Finds Trusted Platforms Like DocuSign and Google Calendar Are Now the Primary Email Attack Surface
articles.summary: PR Newswire: StrongestLayer Research Finds Trusted Platforms Like DocuSign and Google Calendar Are Now the Primary Email Attack Surface. StrongestLayer today released a new threat intelligence report, What Your Email Security Can't See, analyzing 2,042 advanced email attacks that successfully bypassed Microsoft Defender E3/E5 and market-leading secure email gateways before being detected by StrongestLayer. The findings highlight a fundamental shift in attacker behavior, where adversaries increasingly hide behind business-critical platforms such as DocuSign, Microsoft, and Google Calendar—services organizations cannot block withou Related tickers mentioned: GOOG, MSFT.
